title: The reference run.
caption: Commands are numbered as in the live experiment. CPU is the host CPU instructions of each applied, signed transaction in soroban-sim with soroban-env-host {{fact:soroban-env-host-sim}}, applying with enforcing authorization, so `__check_auth` and verifier calls are included. The host is simulation's recording-mode build, not the exact-metering one, so counts can differ from stellar-core's metering. Refusals are caught in enforcing simulation and never submitted. Auth errors {{fact:auth-error-stale-scope}} and {{fact:auth-error-rule-eval-refused}} are `__check_auth`'s codes inside {{fact:host-auth-error}}; {{fact:account-error-scope-live}} and {{fact:account-error-wiped-credential}} are account entry-point errors.
rows: Old owner installs; re-grant the wiped key
Install grant 2; spend 2 with grant 2; collect grant 1
Game with missing or wrong authorization, either outcome
Refused (host authorization error, or auth error {{fact:auth-error-rule-eval-refused}} for a wrong credential)
